title: AI Resume Screening System
description: An automated system that parses uploaded resumes, extracts key skills, and ranks candidates against job descriptions.

modules.name: Document Parsing
modules.description: Extracting text from PDF, DOCX, and image formats using OCR and libraries.

modules.name: Named Entity Recognition (NER)
modules.description: Using NLP to extract skills, experience years, education, and contact info.

modules.name: Semantic Matching Engine
modules.description: Using vector embeddings to compare resume text with job requirements.

modules.name: Bias Mitigation
modules.description: Filtering out identifying information to prevent unconscious bias in initial screening.

project_objectives: Accurately extract skills from 95% of varied resume formats

title: Predictive Maintenance for Manufacturing
description: A machine learning pipeline that analyzes sensor data from factory machines to predict failures before they happen.

modules.name: Data Ingestion & Cleaning
modules.description: Processing raw vibration, temperature, and acoustic data from machine sensors.

modules.name: Feature Engineering
modules.description: Creating rolling averages, frequency domain features, and anomaly scores.

modules.name: Model Training Pipeline
modules.description: Automated retraining of models as new failure data becomes available.

modules.name: Alerting Dashboard
modules.description: UI highlighting machines with high probability of failure in the next 7 days.

project_objectives: Deploy model updates without system downtime

title: Intelligent Customer Support Chatbot
description: A conversational AI agent capable of resolving customer order queries, processing returns, and escalating to humans when necessary.

modules.name: Intent Recognition
modules.description: Understanding user queries (e.g., 'Where is my order?' vs 'I want a refund').

modules.name: System Integration
modules.description: Connecting the bot to the company's order management API to fetch real data.

modules.name: Human Handoff
modules.description: Seamlessly transferring the chat history to a live agent if the bot is stuck.

modules.name: Conversation Analytics
modules.description: Tracking bot resolution rates and identifying common points of failure.

project_objectives: Resolve 50% of incoming customer queries without human intervention

title: AI Image Generation Service
description: A SaaS platform allowing users to generate marketing assets and graphics using fine-tuned Stable Diffusion models.

modules.name: Prompt Interface
modules.description: Frontend for users to enter prompts, negative prompts, and select styles.

modules.name: Asynchronous Job Queue
modules.description: Managing GPU utilization by queuing generation requests efficiently.

modules.name: Model Checkpoint Manager
modules.description: Loading different fine-tuned models based on user selection (e.g., anime, photorealistic).

modules.name: Gallery & Cloud Storage
modules.description: Saving generated assets to S3 and displaying them in a user gallery.

learning_outcomes: Managing GPU resources and asynchronous queues
project_objectives: Optimize GPU usage to reduce generation cost
Keep average wait times under 15 seconds

title: Financial Fraud Detection Engine
description: A real-time scoring engine that evaluates credit card transactions for fraudulent patterns within milliseconds.

modules.name: Real-time Feature Store
modules.description: Using Redis to quickly access historical user behavior (e.g., average spend, locations).

modules.name: Low-Latency Inference API
modules.description: Deploying the ML model to evaluate transactions in under 50ms.

modules.name: Feedback Loop
modules.description: System for fraud analysts to label transactions, automatically feeding back into retraining.

modules.name: Explainability Dashboard
modules.description: Providing analysts with SHAP values explaining *why* the model flagged a transaction.

project_objectives: Reduce false positive rates while maintaining high fraud detection
